tools.name: add_to_basket
tools.description: Add a menu item to the current basket by its id (as returned by search_menu).

itemId.description: The item id returned by search_menu.

quantity.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get the current store name, address, phone number, supported order occasions and opening hours.

tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Search the current restaurant menu by keyword and return matching items with their id, name and price.

query.description: Words to match against item names and descriptions.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Return the checkout URL for the current basket so the customer can review and pay.
